release_read.basis: Q3 revenue RMB1,068.3m missed the company's own RMB1,100-1,150m guide (~3% below the low end) and shipments of 729,673 missed the 800-850k unit guide; the Q4 revenue guide (RMB1,100-1,150m) is only what Q3 was supposed to be, net income -68.5% y/y and gross margin down to 41.0%, all into a +16% run-up. Sized near the option-implied 6.5%.

release.headline: Hesai Group Reports Third Quarter 2026 Unaudited Financial Results

vs_bar.metric: revenue vs company Q3 guide (low end)
total lidar shipments vs company Q3 unit guide (low end, per stage E-P hunt/judges)

vs_bar.consensus_source: Nasdaq EPS forecast in brief (1 estimate)
vs_bar.note: Release reports GAAP RMB0.06 / non-GAAP RMB0.09 per ordinary share (US$0.01); ADS ratio not confirmed in the fetched text, so no per-ADS comparison. Net income RMB80.8m (-68.5% y/y), non-GAAP RMB119.0m (-58.6%).

key_line.metric: Q3 unit shipments vs 800-850k guide; FY 3.0-3.5M unit target
key_line.detail: 729,673 units (ADAS 638,055, robotics 91,618), below the 800-850k guide the thesis said was hard; robotics lidar fell from 142,371 in Q2 per MLQ. Gross margin 41.0% vs 42.1% a year ago. No FY unit figure in the fetched text.

guidance.detail: Q4 2026 revenue RMB1,100-1,150m, the same range Q3 was guided to and missed; implies a soft H2 against the FY unit target. SGI 2026 revenue RMB200-300m reaffirmed; actuation modules guided to six digits in 2027. 'Lowered' is our read of the implied FY path, not a stated cut.

call.detail: Call at 07:00 ET, before this review; Benzinga transcript snippet says ADAS came in a little below previous expectations. Physical-AI/actuation-module growth (+96.8% q/q) is the bull talking point. No further call risk in the session.

public_reaction.summary: Headlines lead on net income -68.5% (Rallies, StockTitan) and a miss of its own revenue guide (MLQ); Quiver frames it as 'expanding Physical AI momentum'. No analyst actions found this morning. Retail tone not observed.

tape_read.note: Robust reference 14.01 (-2.1%) against a -6.5% release read and a 6.5% implied move; range 14.00-15.20, so the pre-market traded up first and sagged to its low, but the last print (09:15) is 14.45 (+1.0%), so the tape is noisy. 57 prints, 8 in the last 30 min, not stale. Market weak (QQQ -1.0%, IWM -0.9%).

thesis_check.note: The thesis was that the 800-850k Q3 unit guide and the FY target were out of reach; units came in at 730k and revenue below its own guide, with a flat Q4 guide.

expected.open_lag_note: The pre-market is live but split (median 14.01 vs last print 14.45, a run to 15.20 then a sag), so the open may hold less of the -2.1% than usual; a bmo name with a clear guide miss, a weak tape for Nasdaq and Chinese ADRs, and a read well beyond the pre-market argue against a fade toward yesterday's close by 10:00.

recommendation.limit_basis: Buy-to-cover limit at 13.45, about -6.0% against the 14.31 close: roughly 92% of the 6.5% option-implied move and close to the -6.5% release read; below every pre-market price (low 14.00), so it is beyond the pre-market on the short side. If it is not filled, the position goes at the close.
recommendation.reason: Hesai bleef onder zijn eigen omzetprognose en onder de verwachte leveringen (730.000 tegen 800-850.000 lidars), en de prognose voor Q4 is alleen wat Q3 al had moeten zijn. De voorbeurs (circa -2%) houdt veel minder in dan dat rechtvaardigt, en bij een ochtendcijfer loopt de koers meestal de hele dag nog door. Laat de short open met een kooporder op 13,45 dollar; wordt die niet geraakt, dan sluiten we bij het slot.
recommendation.what_would_change_it: Staat de voorbeurs vlak voor 09:30 duidelijk boven 14,45 dollar (boven de slotkoers van gisteren) en blijft hij daar, dan liever direct bij de opening sluiten.
